email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Lee, saw dbt Labs crossed $100M ARR and 5,000 customers, then closed the Fivetran merger to build the data infrastructure for AI agents.

A merger at that scale usually means more major accounts in play than the team can cover while the combined motion settles, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lee, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Post-merger, the majors target usually grows faster than the team can cover, especially across two combined customer bases. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lee, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data infrastructure teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lee, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling majors pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while the Fivetran merger settles, no problem at all. Integration is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a majors-sales motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
